T1vPOG71oHk.desc:
GTA 6 BEGINNERS GUIDE: GTA 6 Tips & Tricks You NEED To Know!
►If you enjoyed the video, please consider hitting 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe for more!
►https://youtu.be/5Z7T-ppd0gY?si=roMRI0P4asAc6VWA

The ULTIMATE GTA 6 beginners guide: 33 GTA 6 tips and tricks I wish I knew before I started playing. After 10+ hours in Leonida on PS5 Pro, here's everything you need to know to protect your money, build up Jason and Lucia, lose the cops, and get the best possible start in Grand Theft Auto VI. Every tip is checked in my own game, and there are no story spoilers.

💰 MONEY Cash in your pocket is gone when you die or get busted. Hide it under the floorboards in Jason's bedroom, then bank it at an ATM once the bank unlocks in the mission Buck Me. Loot bags are lost on death too, but guns you've bought come back. Loot enemies you take down for cash, ammo and weapons.

💪 GYM, FOOD & FOCUS Work out 3 days in a row to build strength and Focus. Weights build strength and health, cardio builds stamina, and eating at home gives you a buff. Click both sticks for Focus to see enemies through walls, safe codes and alarmed doors. Petting animals and helping neighbours fill your Focus back up.

🚓 THE POLICE Cops aren't on your minimap anymore. They find you through witnesses and cameras, so change your car colour, your look and your outfit to get away. Register stolen cars, and watch out for cars with trackers.

🚗 CARS Scan cars with the WAiNK app before stealing them, get free repairs at Joey's, watch your fuel, use Paradise Taxi to fast travel, use the car controls for windows, headlights and hazards, and shove your car back over if you flip it.

🗺️ EXPLORING The full map starts hidden under fog. Walk, drive or fly over each area to reveal it, and check the Exploration tab for neighbour favours. Sleep to skip time, and repair your house.

🎯 FIRST PERSON There's no first-person mode, but certain gun attachments let you aim in first person.

👩 PLAYING AS LUCIA You first play as Lucia in Day Release at the end of Chapter 1, but you can't swap freely between her and Jason until Chapter 2. Then hold Right on the D-pad to switch.

50 Easter Eggs & Secrets in GTA 6! From a dog riding a jet ski to a UFO abduction in Port Gellhorn, we’re hunting down some of the strangest GTA 6 Easter eggs, secrets, and mysteries hidden across Leonida. Some are easy to miss even when you’re looking right at them. One of my favorite GTA 5 callbacks is something you’ll recognize with your eyes closed.

🏠 Jason’s safehouse is packed with Rockstar references. We take a look at Michael’s boat, a GTA 5 map, and the wind chimes that longtime players will recognize as Michael De Santa’s ringtone. There’s also a Fabian magazine, a Liberty City reference in Lethal by Design, and ORCA’s parody of David Goggins.

🛸 GTA 6 UFOs and aliens get their own deep dive. We visit the UFO house, investigate the Port Gellhorn abduction, and explore two alien labs. One of the best clues is small enough to fit on a bumper. The Lil’ Probe’Inn sticker reads “Introvert but willing to talk about the 1992 Area 69 incident,” a callback to GTA San Andreas.

🌴 GTA 6 mysteries take us from the Grassrivers Skunk Ape to the meteor crater and strange rock formation on Mount Kalaga. Along the way, we find Grand Senora Desert postcards, a secret bunker, a monster crab, and a snake jump scare. Keep an eye out for the bird’s nest, too.

🎮 GTA 6 cameos and Rockstar callbacks include Tommy Iguana, the purple hippo, Mr. Raspberry Jam, and the lawn gnomes. Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following Grand Theft Auto V (2013), and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.

Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.

Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 17 million digital copies, generating over $1.6 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. O_4BX8VTuDk.title: GTA 6 Easy EARLY Money: Gang Hideout Hit (Chapter 2)
O_4BX8VTuDk.desc:
Need money fast in GTA 6? This is one of the best ways to make money in early chapter 2: one gang hideout in Port Gellhorn that pays up to $13,500 in a single visit, plus a free rocket launcher, sticky bombs and a grenade. And it's actually quite easy.

In chapter 2 money gets tight fast. The motel wants rent, and the story won't let you leave for Vice City until you've saved $15,000. Brooks Boatworks is a Kolt & Associates illegal operation that opens the moment chapter 2 starts, and with the right route you can clear most of it without firing a single shot.

In this GTA 6 money guide you'll see:
- Where Brooks Boatworks is on the map (north-east Port Gellhorn, by the big bridge)
- How to get in quietly when both main gates are locked
- How to take guards down silently so nobody raises the alarm
- The first safe: no code, opens with a screwdriver ($1,400 to $1,800)
- Where the drugs are and how much the stash bag is worth (around $1,300)
- The free rocket launcher, 2 sticky bombs and a grenade
- The big safe: location, the safe code 6823, or blow it with a sticky bomb ($2,000 to $3,600)
- What happens when the shooting starts and the cops surround the place
- Two ways out: the orange Vapid Smuggler Caracara (worth $6,325) or the safe escape by boat
- How to sell the bag to Dunk and keep your cash safe in BuckMe

Total payout: around $7,600 by boat, up to $13,500 if you also drive out in the truck. Amounts vary a little between runs.

Why this is one of the best early money methods in GTA 6
Gang hideouts (illegal operations) are some of the highest paying jobs you can do early in GTA 6. Store robberies pay a few hundred dollars, selling cars to Moses pays one to three thousand, but a single high security hideout like Brooks Boatworks pays thousands in cash, drugs you can sell, a standout vehicle and free weapons in one go. Robbed hideouts come back later when the gang regroups, so you can hit them again for more valuables.

Quick tips
- Bring body armour and a rifle or shotgun
- Stay crouched and take guards down from behind
- Grab the sticky bombs before the big safe
- If there's no shooting and no cops, take the truck. If the cops are outside, leave by water
- Bank your cash at an ATM: if you get wasted or busted, the cash in your pocket is gone

Did you get the truck out, or did you take the boat? Tell me in the comments.

-eLZbZSZizU.title: GTA 6 Safe Codes: Why Robbery Codes Are Random + 6 Fixed Codes That Work

chapters.title: Before the code: crowd, alarm, cameras
How to get any robbery safe code
Search the office, loot guards, Focus Mode

-eLZbZSZizU.desc:
SPOILER WARNING: names story/side missions from Chapters 1-3.

There is no master list of GTA 6 robbery safe codes, because they're random every time. Find the code on site, threaten an employee, or force the safe. Six safes do have fixed codes, and this video gives you those six, plus three confirmed keypad bonuses.

The 6 fixed safe codes
2008 - Afternoon Delight, Delights club office, Port Gellhorn
1680 - Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Casa de Empeño
6815 - Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Richardson Jewelry
0104 - Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Donovan Banks and Co. (keep the leading zero)
0072 - Pelican Valley crab research outpost ("double success")
6823 - Brooks Boatworks (Kolt and Associates hideout, Port Gellhorn)

Keypad bonuses (not counted in the six)
0420 - Lab Fees, Key Lento lab door
7700 - Lab Fees, Brian's lockup
0212 - Pelican Valley boat garage (note inside the 0072 safe)

Kingpin Bowling: blow the northeast office safe with a sticky bomb. No confirmed code in this video.

How to get any robbery safe code
1. Control the crowd, then disable the alarm (a white panel on the wall, usually in the back room). Deal with cameras too.
2. Threaten an employee and use the "Threaten" or "Safe Code?" prompt.
3. Search the back office: sticky notes, computer screens, maps, notice boards.
4. Loot guards. Some carry the code.
5. Turn on Focus Mode with L3 and R3 (both sticks) to highlight clues.
6. At the safe, the four digits show in the bottom-right of the screen.

If you can't find a code, smaller safes can be picked, lockboxes can be opened with the Snap Gun, and some hideout safes can be opened with a sticky bomb ("Open with Explosive"). Sticky bombs are loud, and people can call the cops.

5AQ7lX6q9qM.title: GTA 6 Lost All Your Money in Chapter 2? Do This First

chapters.title: Where the point of no return is
Set up BuckMe and Family Savings

5AQ7lX6q9qM.desc:
SPOILER: end-of-Chapter-1 mechanics (no plot).
Broke in Chapter 2? Fastest legit money → https://youtu.be/_nH1iQVf548

It's not a bug. At the end of Chapter 1, GTA 6 takes your cash. Before you start Recalibration, put at least five thousand into Family Savings in the BuckMe app, and make a manual save.

Guides disagree on which mission triggers the loss, Recalibration or Tourist Trap, so the safe rule is to prepare before Recalibration. Pocket cash and Jason's house in Key Lento are lost. Game8 and GameSpot say your BuckMe checking balance goes too, so don't count on it. Family Savings is kept. Game8 also says personal vehicles, including Ultimate Edition cars, are lost in that chain. Do not plan on keeping a Chapter 1 car. The money does not come back.

How to prepare
1. Do the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me if you have not already. There is no bank until then.
2. Walk to an ATM and deposit your cash. Use ATM Finder in the BuckMe app. You cannot deposit through the phone.
3. In the BuckMe app, move money from checking into Family Savings (tech4gamers calls this Buck Yourself). Aim for five thousand. I cannot confirm that more than five thousand carries over. Family Savings can never be withdrawn, and it can never be lost.
4. Make a manual save in a separate slot and never overwrite it. Pause, Game, Save Game, pick an empty slot.

Also sell stash bags and drug packages first. Game8 says Donnie's drop-off closes after Swamped, and Brian pays less. Bank before you go have fun: pocket cash is lost if you are wasted or busted.

Chapter 2 asks you to earn again, and savings cannot pay story costs, so this is about not throwing away what you earned, not hoarding every dollar.

RMWPZ3cSF3A.title: GTA 6 - Catch Me If You Can Trophy Guide / Achievement Guide
RMWPZ3cSF3A.desc:
GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Catch Me If You Can Trophy Guide / Achievement Guide - Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. [Bronze]

This is unlocked by stealing one of the large passenger planes that's docked to one of the departure terminals at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It doesn't work with the passenger planes on the airfield, has to be one that's connected to one of the passenger boarding bridges. Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly far enough away from the airport until the trophy unlocks.

The easiest plane is the one connected to departure terminals E3/E4. Drive through one of the fences around the airfield and head straight to the plane. Next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane.

The trophy unlock is a bit delayed, you must fly 1km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. You can also enter the plane by going through the airport terminal on foot, you'll find it docked to departure terminal E3/E4. Going over the airfield is faster though.

KtFwhvi-G3M.title: GTA 6 - UFO Aliens Easter Egg Location - The Truth is Out There Trophy / Achievement Guide
KtFwhvi-G3M.desc:
GTA 6 UFO Easter Egg Location & The Truth Is Out There Trophy Guide / Achievement Guide.

In Grand Theft Auto VI you can find the UFO Easter Egg at the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, specifically at night after 2AM. You have to come solo. It's slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn.

At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car. If the car is there you can trigger the UFO. If it's not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you'll see the UFO (bright blue light in sky). Approach it and the UFO will drop a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help. She asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do this and you'll unlock the trophy.

cz4YPEK-0NE.title: GTA 6 - Let's Go Bowling Achievement/Trophy Guide - Loot All Valuables
cz4YPEK-0NE.desc:
GTA 6 - Let's Go Bowling Achievement/Trophy Guide - Loot All Valuables (Watch, Shotgun, Safe) - Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley (Gang Operation)

Playing together as Jason and Lucia, you will come to a mission where you need to chose who to rob. Here you can select the Kolt’s bowling alley, you can also come back to this mission later on in the game. The bowling alley is located in Kelly County in the south area of Port Gellhorn. Once you come up to the bowling alley, you will be met with a few bad guys out front, take them out and enter the bowling alley. Stay to your right and clear out the bad guys on the way to the room on the right side of the building. Here you will find some cash on the table and a watch in the corner of the room. Then exit out the other side of the room, continuing to clear out the bad guys. Make your way forward to the pool table, where you will find a custom shot gun, the last item to collect will be in a safe. Go through the door on the right and turn to your left, take out the bad guy in the room with the safe, and either add sticky explosives to the safe or use the code “0300” to open the safe and collect all items inside. Make a quick escape back to your car to unlock the achievement.

MCXf0OW2VLQ.desc:
This is a full guide to the GTA 6 Pelican Valley Outpost safe code, door code and computer login, plus everything you can loot inside.

First, pull the lever at the back of the first building so it's up. Inside, the name written near the computer is what you need to log into the Pelican Valley Outpost computer in GTA 6. When you back out, a giant crab grabs you, and spamming X or square gets it off.

The safe code is 0072, and inside the safe you'll find the code 0212. That's the Pelican Valley Outpost door code for the locked door on the other side of the outpost. Behind it is the GTA 6 Pelican Valley Outpost loot: a legendary submachine gun, a stash bag of marked bills worth around 9 or 10 thousand dollars, and a jet ski you can use to get out.

hDxIch5H7iE.desc:
This week’s launch of “Grand Theft Auto VI” is arguably the biggest media and entertainment event of the year. Some might even go further, since gamers have been waiting so long for Thursday’s release — the last “Grand Theft Auto” game came out in 2013 — and FOMO is kicking in among the general public. About 15 million copies of “GTA VI” have already been preordered, according to Sensor Tower data. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss H. Zelnick told investors last week that the sales are at “unprecedented levels.”

Calling “GTA” “the biggest entertainment franchise in history,” podcaster Nick Martell points out that the gross proceeds of the new game will exceed the box office take of “Avengers: Endgame” and have a bigger economic impact than Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour. “The video game industry is now bigger than the movie and the music industry combined,” Martell adds.

WJO_aQus3Y0.title: GTA 6 - Secret Alien Base Questline (Complete Walkthrough)
WJO_aQus3Y0.desc:
GTA 6 - How to Find The Secret Alien Base & UFO Guide. Where to Find Aliens in Grand Theft Auto 6. In this video I'll show you a full walkthrough on how you can find the captured alien and summon the mothership to help you defeat enemies. 


Step 1: Trigger the Kelly County UFO Encounter

Travel to Kelly County after midnight, around 2:00 AM. Drive on the road I'm showing in this video until you spot a car of which all lights are blinking in overdrive. Follow the path up the hill until you get to the UFO. Wait for the cutscene to finish and you'll unlock 'The Truth Is Out There Achievement & Trophy. Once you wake up, your partner will call you and tell you that you've been missing for a few days.

Step 2: Unlock the Abduction Flashback & Map Clue

The next step is to go to any Safe House and using the character that witnessed the UFO. Continue going back to sleep until you trigger a special cutscene in which you're abducted on an alien ship. Proceed through the rooms until you get to the Earth orb. On this, you'll spot a location that is available on your map as well.

Step 3: Solve the Ship Keypad & Control Panel

Count the lines above the keypad. Approach the locked door inside the ship enter the code based on the lines displayed above the keypad (4123). Then, proceed to the four-button console in the next chamber to complete the sequence and return to Leonida.

Step 4: Enter the South Point Airfield Facility

Head to South Point Airfield. Travel to the airfield location pinpointed by the planetarium vision (near the warehouse, bridge, and tower pylon). Break through the fence and climb up onto the roof. You then need to locate the keypad door using the same code as in your flashback (4123) and repeat the same steps with the button and the milk. Afterwards, grab the alien and head back upstairs to be welcomed by the mothership.

tWl5WqKLIEs.title: GTA 6 Paul Walker Car: Where to Find the Fast & Furious Eclipse (Vespucci Island)

chapters.title: The answer: Vespucci Island villa garage

tWl5WqKLIEs.desc:
Free-roam Easter egg, no story spoilers. Rockstar hasn't commented on the tribute.

Paul Walker's green Eclipse is in a villa garage on Vespucci Island in Vice City. Break in, shut off the alarm, smash the window and hotwire it. You can grab it right after the opening.

In GTA 6 the car is a green Maibatsu Penumbra in Fast and Furious-style livery. Game Rant and VGTimes both use that name, with slightly different model badges, so this video just says Maibatsu Penumbra. Calling it a Paul Walker / Brian O'Conner tribute is how players and the press are reading it; Rockstar hasn't said anything about it.

Getting there: Vespucci Island is the residential island between Vice City and the beach. Game Rant's turn-by-turn is to stop at the first crossroad, turn left, and use the first house on the right. VGTimes describes it from the other direction, heading west from Vice Beach, and calls the area the Rialto Islands. grandtheft.gg's landmarks, from one independent source, are a house under construction with a black sign, a white modern house with a blue rooftop umbrella, and across from those a house with a tall hedge and a white rolling gate.

Game Rant says to break in through the small door next to the garage, then use the alarm panel on the far wall and the garage-door switch on that same wall — that's one guide's route. Then break the window and hotwire it. Insider Gaming says the hotwire uses the left and right sticks. Nobody has confirmed you can keep or register this car. grandtheft.gg says they haven't found a method yet. Try the Moses steps in the keep-stolen-cars video and tell me what happened.

Insider Gaming also reports a snake in the trunk, a Toy Story joke. That's one source; other sites repeated them.
